about: The table of tools/workflow-starts.test.mjs: for each event, which jobs of the plain workflows and which gh-aw agents start. 'starts' names the plain jobs (the file stem for the first job of a workflow, stem/job for another), 'agents' the gh-aw definitions. The test file says how to read and extend it.
